title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theatre on 1980-04-01
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 => Grace Design Lunatec V3 >> Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5 -6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96]
source: FOB Master Cassettes MAC = 3 x Maxell XLII C90, 1 x x Maxell XLII C60; 2 x Nakamichi CM700 => Sony TC-D5M >> MAC

ai_review.summary: Superb recording that captures an intense, rare set with a smoking rider and standout jams like Estimated > He's Gone > The Other One and China Cat Sunflower.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the crystal‑clear sound of this tape, calling it “the bomb,” while also celebrating a ferocious performance highlighted by Jerry’s animated playing, a rare Estimated > He's Gone > The Other One sequence, and powerful renditions of China Cat Sunflower and Stella Blue. The only noted blemish is the closing Shakedown, which some feel didn’t serve as a strong encore.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with several standout moments and an excellent‑to‑superb recording quality; limited number of reviews but detailed feedback yields a solid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as “truly amazing,” “superb,” and “the bomb,” indicating very high clarity and overall sound quality.

standout_songs: Estimated > He's Gone > The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert features a rare Estimated > He's Gone > The Other One sequence and an intense, extended rider that kept the crowd dancing. The flow is praised for its energy, though the encore (Shakedown) is viewed as a weaker closer.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as playing at a “ridiculous level,” smiling, animated, and delivering an especially tight 5:30 jam.
